notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage to you equal to the creature's power, with you being unable to lose the game due to Platinum Angel.
Darien triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the damage dealt to you.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to you, with you being unable to lose the game due to Platinum Angel.
Repeat from step 3.
